newsitem.title: USA: Airborne Express adds new facility.
newsitem.headline: Airborne Express adds new facility.

text.p: Airborne Express announced today the opening of a new and expanded facility in the northwest Houston area. ...."The new station can be directly attributed to the tremendous growth we've been experiencing," said Cindy Whitson, Airborne district field service manager

"Airborne, she said,.now has a total of five facilities in the Houston area. The facility consists of 3,525 sq ft of office space and 27,925 sq ft of warehouse with loading positions for five trailers. The carrier's new Houston facility employs 70 people, it said.
